summary_claims.claim: Providers self-classify and notify medium- and high-risk systems (literal: nha cung cap tu phan loai ... phai thong bao ket qua phan loai cho Bo KH&CN, Art. 10(1),(3))
High-risk systems need conformity assessment before use ('phai duoc danh gia su phu hop ... truoc khi dua vao su dung', Art. 13(1))
Machine-readable marking of AI audio/image/video by providers (Art. 11(2)) and labelling of content imitating real persons (Art. 11(4)); literal 'dau dau o dinh dang may doc'
Deployer liable for damage from lawfully used high-risk system, recourse where agreed (Art. 29(2))
Art. 35 transition 18 months (health, education, finance) / 12 months, suspension at risk of serious harm
Gazette No. 40: gazette page lists 'Nam trong cac Cong bao: 40'

note: All summary and notes claims I tested match the Vietnamese text read from the OCR (Arts 1, 4, 5, 7, 9-13, 26, 27, 29, 33-35). 'Controlled testing' is a literal rendering of 'thu nghiem co kiem soat'; the government translation's 'regulatory sandbox' is correctly not used. english_version URL is a stored source (extra-67806931cc). The vote count rests on a news report that the script counts as secondary; it is notes-only. A targeted search found no amending law.
